issues.message: Vault has 15 fetched source notes but ZERO `*Suggested by [[...]]` breadcrumbs. The bouncing reading loop never fired — every fetch was a flat batch with no link back to the source that proposed it. Use `$HPR fetch ... --suggested-by <source-note-id> --suggested-by-reason "<why>"` for every follow-up fetch.

Vault has 15 fetched source notes but only 0 real source-linked extract notes (0% coverage, need ≥5). The analyst was skipped on most sources or the source->extract chain of custody is broken. Spawn an analyst subagent on the unanalyzed sources during curation. Target: at least 1 extract (≥150 words, with `parent=<source-note-id>`) per 3 sources (floor of 1 for any corpus size). Minting stub notes to pass this gate is lint-gaming and will not satisfy.

2 atomic entity/entities from prompt-decomposition.json are missing from the final report: 11 Furlong St, Cockburn Central WA, Cockburn Central house market (1 km radius vs suburb). The draft drifted from the user's explicit ask. Re-spawn the instruction-critic with the missing items flagged, or hand-craft Edits to restore them.

Required format(s) from prompt-decomposition not visibly present in draft: 三事项证据表（事项、发现、范围、数值/原文、来源URL或笔记ID、发布日期、数据期间、访问日期、核验状态）, 支持材料/反对材料/未解决缺口分开写, 区分观察事实、条件计算、推断, 中文报告. This may be a false positive if the format is rendered without the spec word in the prose — review manually.
